proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C H hA hH hperp
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq.mp hH
  set d : V := C -ᵥ B with hd
  set h : V := A -ᵥ AffineMap.lineMap B C x with hh
  have hBH : B -ᵥ AffineMap.lineMap B C x = (-x) • d := by
    rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vsub_vadd_eq_vsub_sub, vsub_self, zero_sub, neg_smul]
  have hCH : C -ᵥ AffineMap.lineMap B C x = (1 - x) • d := by
    rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vsub_vadd_eq_vsub_sub, ← hd, sub_smul, one_smul]
  have hin : inner ℝ (B -ᵥ A) (C -ᵥ A) = 0 := by
    rw [InnerProductGeometry.inner_eq_zero_iff_angle_eq_pi_div_two]; exact hA
  have e1 : B -ᵥ A = (-x) • d - h := by rw [← hBH, hh, vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right]
  have e2 : C -ᵥ A = (1 - x) • d - h := by rw [← hCH, hh, vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right]
  have hdh : inner ℝ d h = 0 := by rw [real_inner_comm]; exact hperp
  rw [e1, e2] at hin
  simp only [inner_sub_left, inner_sub_right, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right, hperp, hdh,
    real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] at hin
  have key : ‖h‖ ^ 2 = x * (1 - x) * ‖d‖ ^ 2 := by linear_combination hin
  rw [dist_eq_norm_vsub V A, ← hh, dist_eq_norm_vsub V B, dist_comm, dist_eq_norm_vsub V C, hBH, hCH, norm_smul, norm_smul]
  rw [key, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_neg]
  by_cases hd0 : ‖d‖ = 0
  · simp [hd0]
  · have hpos : 0 < ‖d‖ ^ 2 := by positivity
    have hnn : 0 ≤ x * (1 - x) := by
      by_contra hc
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖h‖, not_le.mp hc]
    have : |x| * |1 - x| = x * (1 - x) := by rw [← abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hnn]
    linear_combination (-‖d‖ ^ 2) * this
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C H : P), EuclideanGeometry.angle B A C = Real.pi / 2 → H ∈ line[ℝ, B, C] → inner ℝ (A -ᵥ H) (C -ᵥ B) = 0 → dist A H ^ 2 = dist B H * dist H C
